text: Monday evening, April fifteenth, nineteen twelve.
A New Haven paper tells its readers: Titanic afloat. No lives lost.
In New York, crowds push into the White Star Line's office, waiting for names.
But the ship had sunk before dawn, hours before that paper was printed.
Tuesday morning, the New-York Tribune: thirteen hundred and forty dead.
asr: Tuesday morning the New York Tribune 1340 dead

text: In Oregon, the count is fourteen ninety-two.
The Carpathia picked up seven hundred and six people from the lifeboats.
No lives lost, the paper said.
The National Archives count: fifteen hundred and seventeen died.
